root_cause.text: The `bpf_prog_test_run_skb` function fails to initialize the `skb->_skb_refdst` field for `BPF_PROG_TYPE_LWT_XMIT` programs, resulting in a NULL pointer dereference when `bpf_lwt_xmit_push_encap` accesses `skb_dst(skb)->dev`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states that "skb->_skb_refdst may not be initialized when the skb is set up by bpf_prog_test_run_skb function," and the patch diff shows the addition of `skb_dst_set(skb, &net->ipv6.ip6_null_entry->dst)` inside `bpf_prog_test_run_skb` guarded by `if (prog->type == BPF_PROG_TYPE_LWT_XMIT)` to ensure the destination is valid before execution.
